text:
[LSMP.6.1] A uniform random sample destroys temporal structure and, over
all-time, mixes regimes of a non-stationary signal — so it is rarely the right
question for signal processing. It answers distributional / ad-hoc queries
("p37 over a year of readings at fixed memory"), not windowed or spectral ones.
DSP rules want `sliding`/`tumbling` windows or the signal aggregations
([LSIG]); `sample` is an operational-analytics
convenience.
